responsibility: This header defines GCC’s shared fixed-size memory block pool for amortizing malloc/free traffic across pool allocators. It provides the memory_block_pool singleton class, inline allocate and release operations on 64KB blocks with Valgrind annotations, freelist sizing policy, and declarations of obstack chunk hooks that let obstacks reuse pooled blocks. It is the interface for cross-pool block recycling rather than a general-purpose allocator.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/memory-block.cc, which implements the singleton instance, trimming, and obstack hooks, this header defines the memory_block_pool type, constants, inline fast-path allocation/release operations, and external hook declarations.
